newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ahold seeks new $1 bln credit.
newsitem.headline: Ahold seeks new $1 bln credit.

text.p: Dutch supermarkets group Ahold NV said on Friday it had asked ABN AMRO to arrange a new seven year $1 billion multicurrency revolving credit facility.
ABN AMRO would serve as global bookrunner, while Chase Manhattan Bank would act as facility agent and J.P. Morgan Securities as documentation agent, Ahold said.
"The new facility will be used to refinance existing indebtedness of The Stop & Shop Companies...and replace Ahold's existing core facility," Ahold said in a statement.
"The Revolving Credit is a true global facility allowing the company to access funds in various currencies to finance its growing worldwide activities," Ahold said.
Ahold acquired the New England based supermarket chain Stop & Shop earlier this year.
